dataset: CHASE_DB1 (1st observer; no FOV); nnU-Net v2 standard inference pipeline
note: nnU-Net v2 inference used its standard preprocessing, resampling, and normalization (not identical to the raw-image sliding-window PyTorch protocol used for P0/CDC/Attention/Swin). Probability maps were resized to CHASE GT resolution before thresholding at 0.5.
